findings.title: Start storage emulators only for the suites that use them
findings.problem: Each CI run fans out about 200 E2E shards. Every shard spends about 40s starting LocalStack, Azurite, fake-gcs, a Vercel Blob emulator and Redis. About 95% of shards never touch them.
findings.fix: Add storage and redis inputs to the shared start-services action. E2E starts the emulators only for the storage suites.
findings.measured: Over 7.3 days and 690 runs, a sample of 214 runs and 52,161 jobs showed service startup averaging 75s per E2E job.

findings.title: Skip empty "new and changed tests" shards
findings.problem: Every run starts 20 "new and changed tests" shards on 16-core runners. Groups fill from 1 to n, so a PR that touches one test file gets 16 shards that install deps and then print "No added/changed tests detected".
findings.fix: The changes job counts changed test files per mode and emits only min(n, 5) groups. An empty matrix skips the job.
findings.measured: Across 66 runs from Oct 4 to 10, 703 of 820 shard jobs finished in under a minute.

findings.title: Skip secret-dependent matrix legs on fork PRs
findings.problem: Fork PRs don't get secrets, yet 15 cloud and Databricks matrix legs still build and load images, then skip every test.
findings.fix: The set-matrix steps filter out those legs when the PR comes from a fork. Maintainers keep /test-with-secrets.
findings.measured: Oct 4 to 11: 356 of 579 CI runs came from forks. 122 sampled fork runs averaged 9.9 no-op jobs each.

findings.title: Run only the templates a PR changes
findings.problem: Templates is a 25-leg matrix (5 templates x 5 package managers), and every PR runs all of it. Most runs are Dependabot PRs that touch a single template.
findings.fix: A small scope job diffs the commit under test and narrows the matrix to the changed templates. Any other change runs all 25.
findings.measured: Oct 4 to 11: 65 single-template Dependabot runs spent 8,466 rounded min on templates they couldn't affect.
findings.validated: Tested on a fork: changing one template ran 5 legs, a root change ran 25, and a rename ran 10.

findings.title: Warm the mordant cache on main
findings.problem: The mordant-bin cache was only ever saved from PR runs, so every new PR branch rebuilt it from scratch.
findings.fix: Add a path-filtered push trigger on main that only builds and saves the cache. PRs then restore it from the default branch.
findings.measured: In a sample of 62 runs, all 23 misses were a branch's first run, and each miss cost +1.34 rounded min.
findings.validated: Tested on a fork: the push run saved the main cache, and the next PR run hit it.

findings.title: Run the full test tier nightly, as the header says
findings.problem: The workflow header says the full tier is nightly, but 41 full-tier legs also run on every merge to main. Most finish in under a minute.
findings.fix: Gate the 3 full-tier jobs on schedule and workflow_dispatch, the same condition a sibling job already uses.
findings.measured: Oct 10 to 11: the full tier was 79% of push jobs (1,845 of 2,330).
findings.note: Only collaborators can open PRs on this repo. The branch is ready.

findings.title: Skip full CI on stacked-PR layers
findings.problem: Stacked-PR layers were 18% of branches but 57% of PR CI runs, and 74% of those runs were cancelled after restacks.
findings.fix: Fall back to uv's own test:skip mode on stack layers unless a label opts in.
findings.measured: Oct 4 to 10: all 1,277 PR CI runs, 58% of them cancelled.
findings.note: Held. uv runs CI on every stack layer on purpose, so this is the maintainers' call.

findings.title: Hourly main CI is almost always red
findings.problem: Hourly main CI failed 182 of 183 runs in a week. Cutting the cadence would break their PR gate, which uses it as a baseline.
findings.fix: Fix the flake first. A smaller side fix moves Hourly Extension Tests to every 3 hours.
findings.measured: Oct 4 to 12: 183 scheduled runs, 182 failed, 187,765 rounded runner-min.
findings.note: Held. This needs a diagnosis, not a CI tweak.

findings.title: Cancel superseded benchmark runs
findings.problem: The benchmark workflow has no concurrency group, and 30% of PR runs were superseded but still ran all 4 shards.
findings.fix: Add a per-PR concurrency group with cancel-in-progress.
findings.measured: Oct 8 to 12: 14 of 46 PR benchmark runs were superseded, wasting 274 rounded job-min.
findings.note: Held. Astro's CI is already tight, and this one is small.
